question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Acquitted".
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) Convicted.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Convicted** means to declare someone to be guilty of a criminal offense by the verdict of a jury or the decision of a judge in a court of law. This is the direct opposite of acquitted, which means to be free from a criminal charge by a verdict of not guilty. (दोषी ठहराया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** He was convicted of fraud after a lengthy trial.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Convicted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Pardoned** (माफ़ किया हुआ): Forgive or excuse (a person, error, or offense) typically as an act of clemency.

 
 
• **Example:** The president pardoned the prisoners as an act of mercy.
 
 
 
• **Exempted** (छूट दिया हुआ): To free from an obligation or liability to which others are subject.
 
 
• **Example:** He was exempted from paying taxes due to his financial status.
 
 
 
• **Liberated** (मुक्त किया हुआ): To set free from imprisonment, slavery, or oppression.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers liberated the town from occupation.
 
 

4b:T8df,
The correct answer is: Option 1) We had a terrible row last night.</b
